clause: Color models MUST include, deduped across suites: - [STU-COL-002] Color models MUST include, deduped across suites enumeration
spec_anchor_status: RESOLVED: derived from the assembled Master Spec module, not provisional

scope.summary: Color models MUST include, deduped across suites: | Studio color model | Channels / role | Bit depths | Provenance | |---|---|---|---| | RGB | Additive three-channel working/display space | 8 / 16 / 32-bit | PS/AI/ID/AF/Figma | | CMYK | Four-plate subtractive prepress space, device-dependent profile | 8 / 16-bit | PS/AI/ID/AF | | Lab | Device-independent lightness + a/b opponent channels | 8 / 16-bit | PS/AI/ID/AF | | Gray | Single-channel tonal | 8 / 16 / 32-bit | PS/AI/ID/AF | | Bitmap | 1-bit black/white with conversion methods (threshold, pattern/diffusion dither, halftone screen, custom pattern) | 1-bit | PS | | Indexed | Palette-limited with palette type, color count, forced colors, transparency, matte, dither, editable color table | 8-bit | PS | | Duotone | Mono/duo/tri/quadtone inks with per-ink transfer curves and overprint colors | tonal | PS | | Multichannel | Channel-per-plate special mode | per-plate | PS |
scope.spec_text_is_authority: The clause text above is quoted from the Master Spec. Where this contract and the spec differ, the spec wins and this contract is regenerated.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The enumeration accepts the member `RGB` with the exact meaning the spec states: Additive three-channel working/display space | 8 / 16 / 32-bit | PS/AI/ID/AF/Figma. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `CMYK` with the exact meaning the spec states: Four-plate subtractive prepress space, device-dependent profile | 8 / 16-bit | PS/AI/ID/AF. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `Lab` with the exact meaning the spec states: Device-independent lightness + a/b opponent channels | 8 / 16-bit | PS/AI/ID/AF. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.
The enumeration accepts the member `Gray` with the exact meaning the spec states: Single-channel tonal | 8 / 16 / 32-bit | PS/AI/ID/AF. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `Bitmap` with the exact meaning the spec states: 1-bit black/white with conversion methods (threshold, pattern/diffusion dither, halftone screen, custom pattern) | 1-bit | PS. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `Indexed` with the exact meaning the spec states: Palette-limited with palette type, color count, forced colors, transparency, matte, dither, editable color table | 8-bit | PS. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `Duotone` with the exact meaning the spec states: Mono/duo/tri/quadtone inks with per-ink transfer curves and overprint colors | tonal | PS. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `Multichannel` with the exact meaning the spec states: Channel-per-plate special mode | per-plate | PS. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence or table row in the cited spec clause. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication and fails the contract.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
For a parameter row, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown rather than mirrored from its opposite.
